{{Quote|Then we're not here in the middle of the galaxy's worst ice cream shop prayin' every day that the Empire doesn't swoop down on us from above? 'Cause the Jedi got rid of all of the evil in the galaxy. Isn't that right?|Reyé Hollis, to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Luke" />}}
'''Reyé Hollis''' was a [[Naboo (people)|Naboo]] [[human]] and a [[sergeant]] in the [[Rebel Alliance Special Forces]]. The [[Gender|man]] from [[Naboo]] was one of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebels]] who participated in constructing [[Echo Base]]. Despite his [[Anti-Jedi sentiment|doubts]] about the [[Jedi Order]], he soon bonded with the [[Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker]].

==Biography==
Reyé Hollis was a [[Naboo (people)|Naboo]] [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who was a [[sergeant]] in the [[Rebel Alliance Special Forces|special forces]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="Luke" /> In [[3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the construction of [[Echo Base]] to [[3 ABY]].</ref> he participated in the construction of [[Echo Base]] in the southern [[Clabburn Range]] on the [[Water|ice]] [[planet]] [[Hoth]]. The harsh conditions were such that Hollis thought the planet was not "hothpitable" and would only appeal to someone on the run, like the Alliance was. He bonded quickly with other Alliance members stationed on Hoth.<ref name="Luke" />

Shortly after meeting the newly arrived [[Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker]], Hollis and Skywalker were trapped together when a giant [[fork-nosed ice worm]] broke through the ground, causing an ice cave-in. Although he initially bickered with the Jedi, he soon trusted him. They worked together to dig their way out of the tunnel.<ref name="Luke" />

==Personality and traits==
Hollis had a [[Color|dark]] [[Hair|beard]] and skin that was darker than his beard, curly hair, and dark [[eye]]s with thick eyelashes. He was [[Anti-Jedi sentiment|skeptical]] of Jedi usefulness, their [[Force power|powers]], and [[the Force]] after hearing stories about how the [[Jedi Order]] failed to prevent the rise of the [[Galactic Empire]]. He often drew comparisons in his speech and thoughts, such as saying Hoth was [[the galaxy]]'s worst [[ice cream]] shop and thinking that Skywalker's blue eyes were like Hoth's sky on a clear day.<ref name="Luke" />

==Equipment==
To cope with the environment of Hoth, Hollis wore a white water-resistant [[Clothing|pants]] and a fur-trimmed parka of the same material, along with gloves, black combat [[boot]]s, and a [[helmet]] with [[goggles]].<ref name="Luke" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] continuity, Reyé Hollis first appeared in the [[2022]] short story "[[Luke on the Bright Side]]" by [[Sam Maggs]], published in the anthology ''[[Stories of Jedi and Sith]]'';<ref name="Luke" /> however, Maggs intended him to be a character that she said was mentioned<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|SamMaggs|status/1534613670994403329|[[Sam Maggs]]|date=2022-06-08|quote=Great question! Reyé Hollis is the same Hollis who is named in the film. The character shown in the photo you attached here is often mistakenly identified as Hollis but is actually likely the character Trey Callum!" … "Since this is Trey and we never actually see Hollis's face in the film, I took my own liberties with what his character looks like when writing the short story! (I also couldn't resist messing with and straightening out a little bit of confusing lore, as a research-lover)|archivedate=20220608191013}}</ref> in the [[1980]] film [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']].<ref name="TESB">{{Film|V}}</ref> In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, one of the extras in ''The Empire Strikes Back'' was identified as [[Reyé Hollis/Legends|Reyé Hollis]], receiving the last name "Hollis" in the [[1998]] [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] set ''[[Special Edition Limited]]''<ref name="Special Edition">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Sergeant Hollis}}</ref> and first name "Reyé" in the [[Star Wars Insider 74|''Star Wars Insider'' 74]] article "[[Who's Who in Echo Base: The Unsung Rebels of the Battle of Hoth|Who's Who in Echo Base]]" by [[Josh Radke]],<ref name="Who's Who">{{InsiderCite|74|Who's Who in Echo Base: The Unsung Rebels of the Battle of Hoth}}</ref> which was published on [[February 26]], [[2004]].<ref name="Insider date">{{SWArchive|url=community/news/2004/01/news20040126.html|text=Clone Trooper Front and Center in ''Insider'' #74}}</ref>
